readings.moment: When the played piquet ended: 'We played until a quarter to eleven by my watch.'
When Vauthier sat down again after fetching his cigar case, the hall clock struck eleven a moment after he did.

durations: two minutes (Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell)
thirty years (Vauthier has dined at this table, more or less)
a moment (between Vauthier sitting down again and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: Vauthier dined at the dining room table.
Aurèle asked everyone at dinner to show him their watches, and Vauthier showed his.
Vauthier and Madame (Odile) sat down to piquet in the salon.
Vauthier got up and went out to fetch his cigar case, which was in his coat in the hall.
Odile began to play the piano as Vauthier went out.
Odile stopped playing when Vauthier came back.
Vauthier sat down again after returning.
Vauthier and Odile resumed the card game.
Vauthier examined Aurèle's body when he was called to him.
Vauthier attended Jules Monnier in his last illness in 1889 and sat with him at the end.
Vauthier fetched the cigar case, from which he now offers a cigar.
